glasswing_sardine.name: Glasswing Sardine
glasswing_sardine.lore: Schools of them skip over the surface like thrown pebbles.
glasswing_sardine.hint: Watch for skipping flashes over the shallows.
glasswing_sardine.signature: body clear as blown glass with one glowing spine line; long wing-like pectoral fins

driftback.name: Driftback
driftback.lore: It lies still among the real driftwood, then bolts.
driftback.hint: Some of the driftwood by the pier is not driftwood.
driftback.signature: a twisted sun-bleached driftwood branch: grain for scales, knot-holes for eyes, dried-seaweed dorsal fronds

compass_flounder.name: Compass Flounder
compass_flounder.hint: Lies flat on the sandy bottom. Sandworms bring it up.
compass_flounder.signature: round flat disc divided into a compass rose by raised bone ridges; needle-spine on its back turns to point north

shellback_blenny.name: Shellback Blenny
shellback_blenny.lore: It bites the hook, then retreats into its shell.
shellback_blenny.hint: Hides in a spiral shell near the rocks. Be patient.
shellback_blenny.signature: lives in a spiral seashell like a hermit crab; only a frilled head and fins stick out

kelp_wraith.name: Kelp Wraith
kelp_wraith.lore: Invisible in the kelp until it moves.
kelp_wraith.hint: Cast into the kelp beds. Its float-bulbs glow at dusk.
kelp_wraith.signature: body built from overlapping kelp blades; amber float-bulbs along the spine glow at dusk

seaglass_puffer.name: Seaglass Puffer
seaglass_puffer.lore: The tide polished it for a hundred years.
seaglass_puffer.hint: Something glints green among the pebbles. Glass shrimp, perhaps.
seaglass_puffer.signature: body is a cluster of frosted sea-glass shards; inflating spreads them into a spiky glass sphere

old_mooring.name: The Old Mooring
old_mooring.lore: The one that got away, for fifty years.
old_mooring.hint: Every angler on the cove has lost a hook to it. Try the deep water off the end of the pier.
old_mooring.signature: huge catfish; barbels are frayed mooring ropes, iron ring through its lip, jaw bristling with old hooks and lures, barnacle-crusted tar-black hide
